words.gram: 3rd person singular feminine, genitive (after a preposition)

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: + dative of the person: обещать вам

meanings.en: to take, to drive (someone to a place)

examples.trans: Afterwards I'll drive you back for free.

to appear, to show up, to turn up

examples.text: Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!
examples.trans: Let him just show up here one more time!
We came up with a good idea.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.
Sit down and hold the door.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Which car did you come in?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: пойти в магазин = to go to the shop

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.trans: I took up so much of your time!

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
в два часа = at two o'clock

examples.trans: I'll be there in an hour.

час.governs: after 2, 3, 4 and полтора the genitive часа is stressed on the ending

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.note: очень приятно = pleased to meet you

examples.trans: I am not allowed to talk with you.
